latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Prompt Archeologist — a skill for extracting high-quality reusable prompts from messy conversations or vague task descriptions.

- Reverse-engineers clear prompts from unstructured user input or chat history.
- Follows a workflow: excavate intent, clarify if needed, draft a portable/parameterized prompt, and explain reasoning in concise notes.
- Always responds to cues like “make this a prompt”, “save this workflow”, or similar, even if “prompt” isn’t mentioned.
- Provides prompts in a copy-friendly format with placeholders and best-use tips.
- Includes excavation notes explaining signals used, any assumptions, and what to customize.
